systems.country_label: comprehensive educational statistical survey; integrated national database
systems.owner: Ministry of Education and National Pedagogy (General Directorate of Educational Planning), with state statistical offices; supported by UNICEF
systems.tiers: Starting in Khartoum, Al-Gezira and Sennar states, expanding nationwide in phases to 7 May 2026; collects counts of schools, students and teachers, services and textbook availability

note: A one-off survey of schools returning counts (schools, students, teachers, services): class census, so no fact. Announced 27 April 2026.
